answer: Admission auctions stop sybil floods. Entry slots go to the highest bidders each epoch, who post a bond of twice their 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs. Paid slots are etched in marble no forger can rewrite, while honest newcomers start their voyage rooted like cedar. Buying 100 slots costs 200 months of earnings, and the bond burns on misbehavior. Honest agents pay once and earn it back from fees; rented reputation is slashed too.
